size.value: 35mm (width) × 40mm (height) per ICP's unified 'Personal Photo Specifications' document. Note: ICP's FAQ page separately states 3.5 × 4.5cm for its general 'Passport & Visa' category — the two official ICP sources are not fully consistent.

head_height.value: Close-up of head and top of shoulders; face takes up 70-80% of the photograph (exact cm figure not stated in the source document)

expression_restriction.value: Look directly at the camera; face square-on to the lens, not tilted, both edges of the face clearly visible; eyes open, no hair across the eyes; natural/colour-neutral skin tone; no shadows, flash reflection, or red-eye.

glasses_policy.value: Sunglasses/tinted lenses prohibited; prescription glasses are permitted only if they do not obscure the eyes and show no glare.

face_visibility.value: Face must be square to the camera (not portrait-style or turned to one side), both edges of the face clearly visible, no shadows across the face.

expression.en: Look directly at the camera; face square-on, not tilted, both edges of the face clearly visible; eyes open, no hair across the eyes.
expression.ko: 카메라를 정면으로 응시, 얼굴을 기울이지 않고 양쪽 윤곽이 뚜렷이 보이도록 할 것; 눈을 뜨고 머리카락이 눈을 가리지 않을 것.
expression.ja: カメラを正面から直視し、顔を傾けず両側の輪郭がはっきり見えるようにすること。目を開け、髪の毛が目にかからないこと。

glasses.en: Sunglasses/tinted lenses prohibited; prescription glasses permitted only if they do not obscure the eyes and show no glare.
glasses.ko: 선글라스·색안경 금지; 도수 안경은 눈을 가리지 않고 반사가 없을 때만 허용.
glasses.ja: サングラス・色付きレンズは禁止。度付きメガネは目を隠さず反射がない場合のみ許可。

face_visibility.en: Face must be square to the camera, both edges of the face clearly visible, no shadows across the face.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴이 카메라를 정면으로 향해야 하며, 양쪽 얼굴 윤곽이 뚜렷이 보이고 얼굴에 그림자가 없어야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 顔はカメラに対して正面を向き、両側の輪郭がはっきり見え、顔に影がないこと。

db_conflicts.research_value: 3.5 × 4.0cm (35 × 40mm) per ICP's dedicated spec PDF; ICP's FAQ separately states 3.5 × 4.5cm for 'Passport & Visa'

cross_verification.note_en: ICP's dedicated 'Personal Photo Specifications' PDF states 35×40mm. ICP's own FAQ page (icp.gov.ae/en/faq/) separately states 3.5×4.5cm for 'Passport & Visa'. Neither of these two official ICP figures matches the DB's 4×6cm. The two official ICP sources are internally inconsistent with each other; this file uses the dedicated PDF as primary since it is the single generically-titled document used across ICP identity services.
